title: Compute equilibrium occupation numbers
action: Solve the static two-electron Hartree-Fock equations for Na (I=5.14 eV, A=0.55 eV, Δ0=5 eV, z0=3 au, image potentials as given in the paper) to obtain the distance-dependent equilibrium spin occupations N_{a,σ}(z) and adiabatic energies E_{a,σ}(z) for work functions in the range 1.5–6 eV. These quantities are required to drive the subsequent dynamic master equations.
description: Intermediate artifact documenting the computed equilibrium occupations and adiabatic energies. Not scored directly, but necessary for the next step.
output_schema: Columns: phi (float, eV), z (float, au), N_sigma (float), N_minus_sigma (float), E_sigma (float, eV), E_minus_sigma (float, eV)

title: Compute charge state probabilities for Na scattering
action: Using the equilibrium occupations from the previous step, solve the coupled semi-classical master equations along the trajectory z(t)=v|t| with v=0.01 au. For each work function phi (1.5 to 6 eV, step 0.5 eV) obtain the asymptotic occupation numbers and convert them to probabilities P+, P0, P- via the combinatorial formulas given in the paper. Perform the calculation for three variants of the decay parameter: gamma_sigma (occupation-dependent), gamma0 (⟨n_{a,-σ}⟩=0), and gamma1 (⟨n_{a,-σ}⟩=1).
description: Final charge-state probabilities for Na scattering at v=0.01 au as a function of work function for the three gamma variants.
output_schema: Columns: phi (float, eV), gamma_type (string, one of gamma_sigma/gamma0/gamma1), P_plus (float), P_zero (float), P_minus (float). Row order: all rows for gamma_sigma sorted by phi ascending, then gamma0, then gamma1.
